extracted.name: Aloo ki akni
extracted.description: #referbysairaabdullah Aloo ki akni bhat easy and yummy hay. Mujay bhat pasand hay.time consuming hay. Jhat pat banay wali recipe. Jub bhat tired hoon tu yeh recipe bana lain.
instruction_lines: In a pan add oil, add in onions. Fry till light golden in color. Add in potatoes. Fry well. Add in chopped tomatoes. Fry well. Add all the seasonings. Mix well. Add 2 cups water. Bhuno well.cook till potatoes tender.
Add 2 glass of water. Add pinch of zafran color. When its start boiling add in rice.cook till rice done. Serve.
